method: rest.json, probe.json and stops.json copied from one accepted `osc-ident step stops` run on the bench servo (mg90-d on dev-v006), each estimate given the sd and n keys the steps now write by hand; window.json and spins.json are synthetic, the window and spins steps' estimate shape carrying the record's values

rest.json.edited: one key added by hand after counts_per_a_nominal: rail_counts_per_v_nominal 248.24242424242425, what Sense::rail_counts_per_v gives on the run's sense block (vdd_mv 3300, vbus_div_top_ohm 6400, vbus_div_bot_ohm 1600, captures/rest/01-rest.meta.json); the run's rest step predates the key; the estimates' sd and n keys added by hand, as the step writes them now: n the rest row's 20000 rows (vdd_v 1), no sd

probe.json.edited: the estimates' sd and n keys added by hand, as the step writes them now: n part_a.pooled.pairs, no sd

stops.json.edited: the estimates' sd and n keys added by hand, as the step writes them now: sd the median times sd_share and n of the file's seated.all (r_ohm, r_25c_ohm, l_h; tau n alone), the band one sd either side

window.json.from: synthetic, from measure/testdata/mg90-d/measured.json; sd half the record's band, n the notebook's 105 onsets

spins.json.from: synthetic, from measure/testdata/mg90-d/measured.json; sd half the record's band, n a bench run's counts (captures/dsr-gate: 12 coasts, 6 run-ups, 6 line points)

table.json.from: synthetic, the table step's result shape: points_by_page the pooled fit (postable::fit_pooled, SMOOTH_WEIGHT) of testdata/table pass-1 and pass-2 (bringup capture A's 20 % passes) compensated with the slots of record, pinned to the stops 107 and 3729 of stops.json rounded inward; slots of record (testdata/mg90-d/wide-codes.json); scale from the ripple, the nameplate's brushes 2 x rotor_segments 3 and its gear_ratio
